<!-- main-pr465-merged-pr584-local-fix-20260918 -->
The daemon merged #465 at23:48:57Z as
`b89f5896245d67dec5d468b69d237d3bafb9b638`, closing issue #463.
Parents are published-main `4613fdc7` and approved head `287ddbc2`;
the subject ends `[lean 0]`. The final contribution documents conditioning
and support estimates without changing Lean statements or proofs.

Fresh bounded integration review
[5242485046](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/pull/465#pullrequestreview-5242485046)
preserved F1-F8 resolutions and found no new defects. MAIN checked the actual
head/body/marker/verdict/publisher, zero unchecked findings, all nine CI
contexts, rooted audit1656PASS0FAIL3statement warnings, clean synchronized
primary, freshness and absence of open463 sub-issues before summary success.
Four full reviews and the earlier terminal assessment remain counted; this
was neither automatic carry nor a fifth full proof review. The reviewer
corrected the brief/helper count to705 changed lines (690+15); added/removed
bytes remain identical, with two differing context lines.

Carver `01a0b1bc-31fe-7480-8056-77365449f98c`, Sol/Ultra, completed
23:38:16.013Z-23:44:06.229Z,350.216 seconds within480. Actual delta:
3093883 input,2952320 cached input,13379 output,3059 reasoning tokens.
The thread retired and claim released. Receipts stayed outside primary
through the merge, then were archived in
`native-reviews/pr465-287ddbc2-01a0b1bc/`.

The first post-merge warmer produced a partial cache after168 seconds:
SupportMass encountered an invalid-header read of a shared Mathlib .ir file.
One canonical retry completed in101 seconds without changing source or the
read-only shared package store. The current complete snapshot is
`snap-20260917T235718Z-b89f5896245d`. Both attempts and the unresolved cause
of the initial read failure are recorded; no partial snapshot is reported complete.

#584 F1 is fixed locally at `2c84b407`: four lines of incompatible detailed
argument are removed from the certified unitary proof, leaving the actual
two-producer composition and its dependency list. The theorem statement,
nested scale, conditional markers and other mathematics are unchanged.
Blueprint render/sync/citations/LaTeX lint, normal hooks and hash checks passed.
Publication, exact-head CI/rooted audit and a fresh independent F1 recheck
remain; MAIN retains the reservation through those publication gates.
The first adverse review remains intact, and no absorption or final-soundness
completion is claimed.

Plato `01a0b1c7-79d3-73e2-9bfe-ee2f76e1d667`, Sol/Ultra, ran
23:50:35.280Z-23:56:56.149Z,380.869 seconds including20.869s over360.
Actual delta:2960163 input,2848512 cached input,13380 output,4839 reasoning.
The one recorded task turn, overrun, source artifact and supplemental receipt
hashes are archived in `native-audits/pr584-f1-prose-01a0b1c7/`; thread retired.

The helper already claimed #271, so it keeps that update. The queue now says
#580 immediately after271, before274, with existing reviews retained.
The required snapshot completed. This cycle merged #465, recovered its cache
and completed the local F1 repair. Caps0/0/0, no lanes or open native threads,
only daemon merges, no #168 post. The formalization goal remains active.
